name: scenescout-mod
description: Optional Claude Code mod for SceneScout: a guided panel (/scenescout-guided) that starts a check in plain words, follows it and shows what it found; a question before Claude starts a check that may send things to your site; and an opt-in model for lane agents. Needs the scenescout plugin or server.

lane_model.title: Lane agents' model
lane_model.description: The model a SceneScout lane agent runs on, as an alias (sonnet, haiku, opus) or a full model id. Empty leaves the choice to Claude Code and the planner.

mcp_server.title: SceneScout server name
mcp_server.description: The SceneScout MCP server's name as /mcp lists it, when it is not 'scenescout' or the plugin's own 'plugin:scenescout:scenescout'. Empty tries those two.

game.title: Game layer
game.description: On draws a bestiary of the open problems in the guided panel, defeated by a re-check that finds one gone. Off by default. It changes no word on a card, the report or a ticket, and is never in anything shared.
